nodes.description: Owned.owner: current owner address, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
ShanxiCoin.balances: mapping(address => uint) token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
ShanxiCoin.allowed: nested allowance mapping(spender => amount) mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
ShanxiCoin._totalSupply: fixed token supply of 1000000000000000000000000000 assigned in the constructor.
ShanxiCoin.symbol: token symbol string, set in constructor.
ShanxiCoin.name: token name string, set in constructor.
ShanxiCoin.decimals: token decimals (18), set in constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with division-based overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): caller must equal newOwner, then owner is rotated and newOwner cleared.
ShanxiCoin() constructor: initialises symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address.
ShanxiCoin.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ShanxiCoin.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
ShanxiCoin.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
ShanxiCoin.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ShanxiCoin.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balance and allowance of msg.sender.
ShanxiCoin.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ShanxiCoin.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Anonymous payable fallback function that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
ShanxiCoin.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: forwards arbitrary token transfers to owner.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made before state finalisation - reentrancy surface.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with an attacker-controlled token address - reentrancy/arbitrary-call surface.
